phaseInterpretation.kind3: Normal deferred DrawPrepared path: phases11 means p0..p10 valid plus tail_us, p11=-1. Never require12.
phaseInterpretation.p1: Initial resource preparation; contains nested kind4 total. Do not add them.
phaseInterpretation.p4: Remaining resource-family preparation before drawable acquire.
phaseInterpretation.p5: Drawable acquisition interval including nextDrawable; reported separately.
phaseInterpretation.p10: World/pass/postprocess/UI GPU command encoding until existing Mark10.
phaseInterpretation.tail: After Mark10: FinishResourceCommit, resident-count/closure setup, SubmitAndDefer and ownership transfer/return. Not exclusive submit time or GPU completion wait.
phaseInterpretation.kind4: Nested initial preparation detail; p8/p9/p11 largest observed medians; source owner interprets exact existing boundaries.

limits: CPU scope intervals are nested; no sums across scopes or medians as a frame-total reconstruction.
Main loop kind1 is sampled1/16; actual emitted rows/coverage retained without extrapolating unsampled owners.
CPU timer and submission scopes do not establish exclusive GPU or driver cost.
Normal process/scene checks are preserved; no whole-game or pixel equivalence claim.
